::: {.cols}
[My research focuses on organization design, in particular on novel and non-hierarchical forms of organizing. Two lines run through the work: coordination inside non-hierarchical organizations, and non-hierarchical organizing across organizational boundaries. Technology, which makes new coordination arrangements possible, connects the two.]{.lede}
:::

```{=html}
<div class="filter" role="group" aria-label="Filter papers by theme">
  <button type="button" data-filter="all" aria-pressed="true">All</button>
  <button type="button" data-filter="coordination" aria-pressed="false">Coordination without hierarchy</button>
  <button type="button" data-filter="learning" aria-pressed="false">Learning in online communities</button>
  <button type="button" data-filter="ai" aria-pressed="false">Algorithms and AI</button>
  <button type="button" data-filter="blockchain" aria-pressed="false">Blockchain and decentralized organizing</button>
</div>
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  var btns = document.querySelectorAll('.filter button');
  function apply(t) {
    btns.forEach(function (b) { b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b.dataset.filter === t)); });
    document.querySelectorAll('.pub-list').forEach(function (list) {
      var stage = null, stageHas = false, any = false;
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(list.children, function (el) {
        if (el.classList.contains('stage')) { if (stage) stage.hidden = !stageHas; stage = el; stageHas = false; return; }
        if (!el.classList.contains('pub')) return;
        var show = t === 'all' || (' ' + el.dataset.themes + ' ').indexOf(' ' + t + ' ') > -1;
        el.hidden = !show; if (show) { stageHas = true; any = true; }
      });
      if (stage) stage.hidden = !stageHas;
    });
    var u = new URL(location); if (t === 'all') u.searchParams.delete('theme'); else u.searchParams.set('theme', t);
    history.replaceState(null, '', u);
  }
  btns.forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener('click', function () { apply(b.dataset.filter); }); });
  var t = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('theme');
  if (t && document.querySelector('.filter [data-filter="' + t + '"]')) apply(t);
});
</script>
```
